author: retfatlanta
quote: From what I've played, I can't say this game should be called 'Grand Theft Auto', because this one is not it. Basically, everything is a literal downgrade from previous GTA games. They took RDR2 and painted it into Vice City universe, but they took everything they shouldn't, plus they made it woke, a lot. Jason is a biggest simp I've ever seen and Lucia is a boring woman. Feels like you are playing some kind of Netflix movie or SIMS. They literally disabled everything that could be funny in this game. Only positive in this game is graphics and they look really good. But, having it on 30 FPS lock is a disaster for a 2026, that's for sure. I can't recommend this game to no one, really, because game for everyone is a game for nobody.

author: retfatlanta
quote: One of the worst games of generation. Where to start? Boring story, boring world, boring quests, bad weapons,bad AI. Can't find anything good in this game.
